items.summary: WPA Day 18 past the April 29 statutory War Powers Resolution deadline is the most sustained unauthorized war-operation continuation in the modern War Powers Resolution era. Sunday's count updates from the prior briefs: the Senate voted on a 7th war powers resolution on May 13-14, and it failed 49 to 50 — the narrowest margin in the series and the first failure after the 60-day statutory deadline had already passed, meaning the stakes of this particular vote were higher than any preceding it. No Project Freedom resumption order was issued on Day 12 of the pause, which is incrementally positive but does not alter the structural WPA posture — the executive retains full operational authority to resume. Trump's bomb threats (renewed through May 16) and the deal's near-terminal status mean the structural logic for resumption is unchanged.
